fact_text: 14 Street Pizza introduced its New York-style Handtoss dough to Pakistan in 2011; the founder developed the recipe, and the company says the dough is kept to one standard in all branches.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a Mother’s Pizza Dough Recipe Built a Pakistani Pizza Empire | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-15)

fact_text: The company began in 2011 as a delivery-only business and focused on delivery until about 2017 before it moved into dine-in restaurants.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a Mother’s Pizza Dough Recipe Built a Pakistani Pizza Empire | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-15)

fact_text: Its first dine-in restaurant opened in Multan, followed by Lahore and Islamabad; its first Karachi dine-in store opened in the Defence area in 2020.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a Mother’s Pizza Dough Recipe Built a Pakistani Pizza Empire | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-15)

fact_text: By August 2025 the company operated 20 stores in 10 Pakistani cities, five of them in Karachi; the Karachi stores are company-owned and the stores elsewhere are franchised.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a Mother’s Pizza Dough Recipe Built a Pakistani Pizza Empire | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-15)

fact_text: The company says about 1,900 people are associated with the 14 Street Pizza brand across Pakistan.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a Mother’s Pizza Dough Recipe Built a Pakistani Pizza Empire | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-15)

fact_text: Franchising requires a one-time fee; the franchisee picks a site, and the company says it keeps other 14 Street outlets away from that site so the franchise gets enough local business.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a Mother’s Pizza Dough Recipe Built a Pakistani Pizza Empire | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-15)

fact_text: A conveyor oven bakes a pizza in about 6 minutes, which the company says keeps the shape, taste and appearance of each pizza the same.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a Mother’s Pizza Dough Recipe Built a Pakistani Pizza Empire | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-15)

fact_text: The menu offers five crust styles: New York, Extreme, Pan, Foot-long and Thin; the Extreme double-decker pizza layers crust, chicken and cheese twice.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a Mother’s Pizza Dough Recipe Built a Pakistani Pizza Empire | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-15)

fact_text: The company describes its imported halal pepperoni, one of its best sellers, as the best halal pepperoni in the world.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a Mother’s Pizza Dough Recipe Built a Pakistani Pizza Empire | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-15)

fact_text: The company says its open kitchen, where customers see preparation, forces a clean kitchen and quality ingredients; the founder's rule is to sell only food he would serve his own family.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a Mother’s Pizza Dough Recipe Built a Pakistani Pizza Empire | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-15)

fact_text: The company says many new players have entered the restaurant market because it looks like an easy business from outside, which makes winning market share harder.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a Mother’s Pizza Dough Recipe Built a Pakistani Pizza Empire | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-15)

fact_text: The interviewee said household purchasing power has fallen because salaried incomes have not risen in line with rising living costs, pushing diners toward cheaper options.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a Mother’s Pizza Dough Recipe Built a Pakistani Pizza Empire | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-15)

fact_text: The company says Pakistani diners are discount-oriented, with the first question at a restaurant being which card gives a discount, which shapes the company's weekday deal calendar.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a Mother’s Pizza Dough Recipe Built a Pakistani Pizza Empire | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-15)

fact_text: As of August 2025, 14 Street Pizza offered 15% off orders placed through its website or app and up to 25% on certain cards.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a Mother’s Pizza Dough Recipe Built a Pakistani Pizza Empire | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-15)

fact_text: The company says Pakistani customers expect a strict service protocol, and even a one-second lapse in service can upset them.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a Mother’s Pizza Dough Recipe Built a Pakistani Pizza Empire | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-15)

fact_text: The founder credits a team that has run the business since day one and says every person, from branch staff to head office, takes ownership of their responsibilities.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a Mother’s Pizza Dough Recipe Built a Pakistani Pizza Empire | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-15)

fact_text: The company says it was an early mover in Pakistan with a food ordering website and its own food app, and that it built brand hype mainly through social media.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How a Mother’s Pizza Dough Recipe Built a Pakistani Pizza Empire | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-15)
